title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1988-09-24
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 analog > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLA
source: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA 90's, no Dolby. Mics on stand on floor near sbd

ai_review.summary: Decent crowd recording captures a party atmosphere even though Jerry’s voice sounds strained.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced tape offers good sound quality for a crowd recording and conveys the festive vibe of the night. While the performance is lively enough to “throw a party,” Jerry’s vocal condition is noted as sub‑par, which may deter purists. Overall it’s an enjoyable listen for those who prioritize atmosphere over pristine audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single 3‑star review; the show is described as fun but with noticeable vocal issues, and the recording is judged good for an audience source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality deemed good for a crowd recording; no specific mix problems mentioned besides general ambient noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewer emphasizes overall party vibe rather than song‑by‑song flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice is described as 'shot' and not at its best.
